diagnostic.transfer: linear stored minimum to maximum grayscale, rounded nearest; no mask; not calibrated visible colour
diagnostic.visualInspection: Whole diagnostic inspected; mixed smooth polar bands and detailed midlatitude model structure. Viewer resized 2222x1111 to 2048x1024. This is a radius-value display, not visible colour, albedo or independently validated local terrain.

limitations: Stored radius is modelled SPC output, not independently validated physical radius or accuracy.

Complete source document crosswalk and quality/special-value assessment remain pending.
Resampled model radius values do not independently establish shape accuracy, self-intersection freedom, registered geography, colour, albedo or chemistry.
Finite positive values and absence of exact9999/99999/999999 do not validate special-pixel semantics, global completeness or interpolation accuracy.
Internal-consistency sigma and poorly constrained polar/model regions retain prior quality limits; no origin shift or repair adopted.
